fnol_text: My name is Samuel Oyelaran and I live at 410 Rowan Way, Salem, MA 01971. You can reach me on (555) 908-6492 or samuel.oyelaran@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 24 September 2026, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2025-00144. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. I assume this is covered under my policy?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Oyelaran on (555) 908-6492 to acknowledge the claim. Samuel confirmed the loss date as 24 September 2026.
Site visit to 410 Rowan Way. Neighbour Noor McBride was present and confirmed the timeline.
Samuel sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
